description: Move or rename a file or folder on a specific instance (by id or exact name). The source no longer exists afterwards, and moving a config file out of place can stop the server from starting. Requires `confirm: true`; show the user both paths first.

confirm.description: Must be set to true. Always show the user both paths before setting this.

from.description: Existing file or folder, from the instance root.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at `to`. Anything already there is lost.

to.description: New location, from the instance root. Rename by keeping the same parent folder.

name: move_path
title: Move or Rename
